Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe

Class TwoFluidComponentTransport

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.TwoFluidComponentTransport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class TwoFluidComponentTransport extends Object implements Serializable
Conservative per-cell, per-phase named-component transport coupled to accepted TwoFluidPipe phase fluxes.

    • beginInterval

    • advance

      public double[] advance(double timeStepSeconds, double[][] phaseMassFaceFluxKgS, double[][] phaseMassSourceKgPerMetreSecond, TwoFluidSection[] sections, SystemInterface inletFluid, SystemInterface fluidTemplate, double tolerance)
      Advance components through one accepted hydrodynamic substep.
      Parameters:
      timeStepSeconds - accepted substep duration
      phaseMassFaceFluxKgS - stage-weighted gas/oil/water face mass flows
      phaseMassSourceKgPerMetreSecond - stage-weighted cell phase sources
      sections - accepted hydrodynamic cell states
      inletFluid - current inlet boundary fluid
      fluidTemplate - thermodynamic template used for cell flashes
      tolerance - relative conservation/synchronization tolerance
      Returns:
      composition-dependent latent heat added in each cell over the accepted step, in joules
